# dsh-model-picker-brand
**Provider logos and model IDs in the DeepSeek Harness model picker.**
The composer's model picker normally shows one line of text — `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash`. This plugin put

s
a **brand logo** in front of every model and adds the **model ID** beside the name, so you can tel

l at
a glance which provider a model belongs to and which exact route you are on.

Zero core changes: it registers a label decorator on the official
`conversation.input.model.label` s
lot. Disable the plugin and the picker is exactly as shipped.

- **22 brand marks** — colored vectors, light and dark themes, 14px and 16px verified
- **Registry-d
riven matching** — provider id, display name (Chinese included), or model prefix; unknown providers

get a letter monogram instead of another vendor's logo
- **Never breaks the picker** — every label r
enders inside a `try/catch` and falls back to `model.name`

Open **Settings → Plugins → Add plugin**, search `dsh-model-picker-brand`, and click **Install**.

Requirements: `dsh >= 0.2.1-rc.2`. No build step, no runtime dependencies.
## 中文说明

输入框的模型选择器从「纯文本模型名」改为「提供商彩色 logo + 模型 ID」：触发按钮显示 `[logo] 模型ID`，
菜单项与列表项显示 `[logo] 名称 + 灰色模型 ID`。零内核改动

——只往官方插槽
`conversation.input.model.label` 注册标签装饰器（priority −10 接管渲染），停用插件即恢复原样。
安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-model-picker-brand`，重启生效。
## What changes
| Where | Before | After |

| Composer trigger button | `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` | `[logo] deepseek-flash` (compact, ID first) |
|

Menu "Model" row | `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` | `[logo] DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash  deepseek-flash` |
| Model li

st items | `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` | `[logo] DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash  deepseek-flash` |
| Unknown provider
| plain text | first-letter monogram in a colored chip |
Hovering any label shows `name · id` as a title.
## How it works
The official picker renders every model label through a slot:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`placement` is `"trigger" | "menu" | "option"`. This plugin registers a decorator on that slot at
**

priority −10**; the slot registry renders the lowest priority, so it takes over the label without
to

uching `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection`. The official badge plugin
(`dsh-client-ui-deeps

eek-model-label-1017`) also registers at priority 0 and is shadowed while this
plugin is enabled — d
isable this plugin and it comes back untouched.

Every label is wrapped in a `try/catch`: any unexpected shape falls back to `model.name`, so the
pic
ker can never fail to render because of this plugin.
## Brand matching
A flat `id → icon` table breaks the moment a provider ships a second id (`zhipu` / `z-ai` / `glm` /
`zcode` are the same vendor). Matching is registry-driven instead — each brand carries three kinds o

f
clues, tried by confidence:
| Order | Clue | Examples |

| 1 | **override** (localStorage) | `{"some-new-provider":"zhipu"}` — no code change needed |
| 2 |
**token** on `provider.id` | `zhipu` `zhipuai` `z-ai` `zai` `glm` `zcode` `bigmodel` `chatglm`; spli

t on separators, longer tokens first |
| 3 | **name** on `provider.name` (Chinese included) | `智谱` `

智谱清言` `通义千问` `月之暗面` `阿里云` `豆包` |
| 4 | **model** prefix (weakest) | `glm-4.6` → Zhipu, `claude-3-7`

→ Claude, `gpt-4o` → OpenAI, `gemini-2.5` → Gemini |
| 5 | no match | first-letter monogram — never
another vendor's logo |
Fix a provider without waiting for a release:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Debug from the browser console: `dshModelPickerBrand.resolve({ id: 'zai' })`.
## Assets and theming

22 brands: colored vectors from svgl, with simple-icons
(CC0) filling the gaps. All trademarks belon

g to their owners; the marks are used only to identify the
service a model comes from.
- **Monochrome marks** (Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama, Qwen, OpenRouter) become `currentColor` and follo

w
the light/dark theme.
- **Colored marks** (DeepSeek, Claude, Gemini, Mistral, NVIDIA, Kimi, Cloudf

lare) keep their real
colors; white details stay white, so a blue tile with a white glyph does not t

urn into a black blob.
- **Z.ai / Zhipu** uses the official logo from z.ai (`#2D2D2D` tile + white h

airline + white Z). The
hairline is what keeps it readable on dark themes at 14px.
- Root `<svg>` fi

ll/stroke are pushed down into a `<g>`; gradient IDs are namespaced per brand so
inline SVGs cannot

d down into a `<g>`; gradient IDs are namespaced per brand so
inline SVGs cannot repaint each other.
